02 / Avia Intelligence AVIA Intelligence

Your clinic, answering every enquiry, day and night.

We create the AI layer for your clinic, so no enquiry goes cold and your best clinician can be everywhere at once. We build and test it in our own studio before it ever touches your diary.

  • AI patient conciergeAnswers treatment questions, triages enquiries and books consultations straight into your diary, around the clock.
  • Avatar clone videosFilm your lead clinician once. Their digital twin then presents treatment explainers, social clips and aftercare videos on demand.
  • AI voice receptionistPicks up every call, reschedules, sends directions and confirms appointments in your clinic's tone.
  • Workflow automationFollow-ups, review requests, recalls and no-show recovery run themselves, connected to your CRM.

04 How we work

A protocol, not a pitch deck.

Clinics run on protocols. So do we, with the same rigour your patients expect from you.

1

Diagnose

A deep audit of your brand, funnel, local market and competitors. We find exactly where patients leak out.

2

Prescribe

A 90-day growth plan with clear priorities, forecasts and one number we hold ourselves to.

3

Treat

Campaigns, content and site improvements shipped every week by a senior team that knows healthcare compliance.

4

Review

An honest monthly review against booked consultations and revenue, then we adjust the protocol.

07 Questions

Asked before you ask.

Three reasons. We work with clinics only, so nothing is learned at your expense. We hold ourselves to one number, booked patients, reviewed with you every month. And there is no lock-in: if the work does not earn its place, you leave.

It is designed for regulated healthcare from the start. Ava answers within the boundaries you approve, never gives clinical advice, and hands anything sensitive to your team. Everything is built and tested in our own studio before it touches your diary.

The audit and 90-day plan come first, then the first campaigns go live within weeks, not months. From there, every month is reviewed against booked consultations and revenue, and the plan adjusts.

No. We connect to the stack you already run, whether that is Pabau, Phorest, Zenoti or a spreadsheet and a phone. Where something is missing, we recommend the lightest tool that does the job.

It depends on which services you combine and the size of your market, so we scope it on the strategy call. Founding clinics get preferential terms while we build our public track record.
